column1: # FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE, Asian release (0100B8A026F14000) on Android (keys in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Game profiles on Android")
# The Korean / Chinese release of FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE, the game the JP profile (dm/games/0100606026F12000) covers: Unreal Engine 5.6.1 on SDK 20.5.17, update 1.0.1,
# the same engine build at the same offsets, and the same 73,496 shader stage/key entries (their package/index ordering differs, so this profile keeps its own tables).
# Its shader libraries are in the IoStore container, Oodle-compressed shader groups that the port decodes with the game's own Oodle on the device (porter device_ue: one
# round, 5,919 groups), so the port needs the device connected, as the JP release does.
# Zero-copy direct GPU texel buffer views allow Niagara particle parameters (R32F, 36-44 elements) to render live battle flames and smoke/dust particles without CPU fallback.
# The system driver crashes in its shader compiler on one of the game's compute shaders, so the port needs a Turnip driver: porter port --vulkan-driver <libvulkan.turnip.so>
# (the GUI's "Vulkan driver" field). Tested with Turnip-26.2.3-EMULATOR (https://github.com/v3kt0r-87/Mesa-Turnip-Builder/releases).

# Retroid Pocket Nova (Adreno 740, Turnip PurpleVK T30, 2026-11-24): the first start's shader-part preparation (gfx_vk_gpl.inc vk_gpl_prepare) went through
# its 73,512 shaders keeping each one's SPIR-V (1.4 GB at 16,384) and the app died at 18 % (native crash, PSS 5.3 GB). A bundle this large is no longer prepared
# whole (DM_VK_GPL_PREP_MAX): a shader's parts are made when the game puts it in a program, on six threads.
# The engine's PSO precaching is compiled into this build with its RHI flag off (GRHIGlobals.SupportsPSOPrecaching, the byte at main+0x8adade2, which no code of
# the build writes; r.PSOPrecaching itself is 1). With the byte set the engine asks for a component's pipelines when the component loads (512 shaders set within
# 3 s of the start) instead of at its first draw. The program call then waits while more than 12 of its shaders are still being made, and texel buffers read as
# floats get their views without a variant. The first field from the save with empty caches: shader parts first made at a draw 65 -> 8, draws left out for a part
# not made yet 641 -> 2. With the driver's cache baked (DM_VK_GPL_BAKE: 138,893 parts, 20-25 min, 871 MB) a part is read back in 0.3 ms and no freeze passes 1 s.

# Frame time, docked (1920x1080 window), Nova, GPU clock at its 680 MHz ceiling, from the save in the first field (300 frames each, cool device):
#   at the save's spot (425 draws)          18.0 ms, 27 dropped -> 16.9 ms, 6 dropped with the replay on its own thread
#   the field's heaviest place (the road    20.4-20.8 ms (48 fps), 68-75 dropped, the GPU busy 18.0 ms of it. The game submits 8 times a frame: with 6
#   down to its end: 841 draws, 145         submission slots each frame's replay waited for the GPU to finish the frame before (gfx_vk_core.c g_nslot).
#   dispatches, 57 passes a frame)          With 16 slots 18.3 ms, 29 dropped, the GPU never idle (99 % busy).
# What is left is the scene's size. The game runs the engine's dynamic resolution between 60 % and 80 % of its 1728x972 picture (r.DynamicRes.OperationMode 2,
# the minimum 60, the maximum 80; 60 / 60 while it loads) but sets the minimum to 80 in the field, and the engine's heuristic did not lower the size here
# whatever its budget. The host steers it (fork_ue_dynres.inc): in that place 60 % (1040x584), GPU 15.3 ms, frame p50 16.7 ms, 1 of 300 dropped; back at the
# save's spot 80 % again within 10 s. The first battle (its opening at 19-21 ms of GPU p90 at 80 %) came down to 60 % in 20 s with frame p50 at 16.7 throughout.
# (DM_VK_FDZ=0 would take another 1.3 ms off the GPU there, 14.0 ms: the game writes the scene depth through gl_FragDepth, so every later draw gets the
# variant that gives up early culling. Left on: without it Adreno drops triangles in some frames of other games, and 60 fps holds with it.)

# Retroid Pocket 6 (8 GB: MemTotal 7.36 GB; the Nova has 11.5): Android's low-memory killer ended the game after four minutes of play (2026-11-25 08:17, exit reason
# LOW_MEMORY at 3.6 GB PSS; it had killed seven background apps in the second before, "device is not responding"). The game holds 2.8 GB at its title, 3.2 GB in
# the first field, 3.4-3.6 in heavier places (Graphics 1.7 GB, native heap 1.3 GB), which leaves 1.4-1.7 GB of MemAvailable there, and the killer acted before the
# backend's own trim level (800 MB) was ever reached. With the levels raised the backend gives back what it can earlier: forced on the Nova (heaviest field) 3.44 ->
# 3.32 GB PSS with the frames as they were (19 against 21 dropped in the field); the Retroid Pocket 6's record at its floor showed 172 MB of kept pool buffers and
# 105 MB of empty image blocks. Not yet measured on that device (adb over Tailscale dies with the background apps). The game's own texture settings did not move
